question: Do the saved slow-control levels track the size of the slow charge precursor or the recorded early PDS activity?
status: Exploratory extension fixed before inspecting the new associations
revision_reason: The initial audit found 935127 timestamps with multiple different archived values, concentrated in derived HV/current channels. Rejecting all such timestamps discarded much of those channels. Preserve each timestamp's median, minimum, maximum and sample count instead; test minimum and maximum envelopes as sensitivities. First-pass files are archived unchanged. Correlation criteria and time bins are unchanged.
scope: Bracket all 1531 local event records against all 34 native archived monitors. Test the existing November waveform metrics separately in runs 32731 and 32739.
SC_level: Median of timestamp-level medians in the window; at least one timestamp. For multiple values at one timestamp, retain their median, minimum, maximum and count. No interpolation or carry-forward. Test medians of timestamp minima and maxima as sensitivity bounds. Record the count, full observed range, maximum step between timestamp medians, preceding/following ages and nearest-sample age.
features: reported-disconnected-input PDS edge size in ADC/256ns
fraction of records with a selected early DAPHNE109 pulse
aggregation: One equally weighted row per source file and UTC time bin; medians of SC level and amplitude, mean of binary PDS-pulse flag. Missing data stay missing.
associations: within-file rank correlation after removing linear time trends from both ranked quantities
coverage_requirement: At least 20 valid aggregated bins, 3 usable source files and 4 distinct SC levels in each run for the primary repeatability screen. Within-file calculations require at least 4 paired bins and varying SC and detector values.
repeatability_screen: Same sign and absolute time-adjusted rank correlation at least 0.30 in both November runs. This descriptive threshold flags follow-up candidates, not discovery significance or proof of no association.
sensitivity_checks: resample whole source files rather than individual events; treat intervals as sensitivity summaries, not population confidence limits
no_claims: shake occurrence or rate versus slow controls
absence of brief unrecorded electrical transients
acceptance: all canonical input hashes and row counts checked
failed query excluded and corrected-voltage retry chunks included
exact boundary duplicates removed; same-timestamp values represented by median and full range, with counts retained
all records and monitors accounted for
all tested associations and coverage failures saved, including any positive result
